component.name: Legcord
component.summary: Legcord is a custom client designed to enhance your Discord experience while keeping everything lightweight.

description.p: Legcord is a custom client designed to enhance your Discord experience while keeping everything lightweight.
Legcord comes bundled with Shelter, Vencord, Equicord and Venmic.

screenshot.caption: Legcord settings open with Shelter configs
Legcord settings open with custom keybind settings shown

ul.li: 🖥️ **Hardware accelerated screensharing on Windows & macOS**
🎨 **Redesigned screenshare picker UI**
🖼️ **Redesigned Settings page, Themes page, About window**
⚙️ **Settings sidebar icons**
🍎 **macOS native system audio loopback capture**
🐧 **Wayland global keybind support**
⚡ **Performance & startup optimizations**
🔒 **Security enhancements & protocol changes**
🖼️ **CSS Editor now loads locally**
🛡️ Fixed potential JS injection via `navigateTo` deep links ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1074](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1074) by @youtsuhodev).
🎙️ Fixed Windows microphone drop in `getUserMedia` patch ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1088](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1088) by @Kolhun).
🖥️ Fixed window state restoration across mixed-DPI multi-monitor setups ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1110](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1110) by @Sickjuicy).
🍏 Fixed macOS traffic light positioning on 'Overlay' window style ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1134](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1134) by @isaxk).
🚀 Fixed blank settings and theme on first launch ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1101](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1101) by @youtsuhodev).

📦 Updated Flatpak metainfo for full Flathub compatibility ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1111](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1111) & [https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1112](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1112) by @imide).
📦 Added license and dependency metadata to Debian target ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1130](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1130) by @renangiuliasse).
🛠️ Updated AppImage toolset per Electron Builder docs ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1136](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1136) by @imide).
🤖 Uploaded `generated-sources.json` with release artifacts ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1119](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1119) by @imide).
🧹 Fixed injection TypeError ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1085](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1085) by @youtsuhodev).

🧹 Resolved all Biome lint errors and formatted codebase ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1100](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1100) & [https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1117](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1117) by @youtsuhodev).
📖 Added clipboard fallback plugin documentation example ([https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1123](https://github.com/Legcord/Legcord/pull/1123) by @NigelThorne).
🧹 Bumped all depedencies
